All objectives complete and verified.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Panel titles on the provisioned dashboard `Service health` (uid `bench-service-health`, at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`), read from the rendered page DOM:
- `Request rate` (timeseries)
- `Error count` (stat)
- `Latency by endpoint` (table)

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard `c2agr2 Bench Dashboard` exists and is saved. It contains a Stat panel titled `c2agr2 Availability` (`type: "stat"`) whose query target uses `datasource: {type: "grafana-testdata-datasource", uid: "benchtestdata"}` — the `TestData` data source (confirmed as the only data source on the instance, named `TestData`).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a Text panel titled `c2agr2 Notes` (`type: "text"`, markdown mode) with content `Run c2agr2 bench notes. Availability panel uses the TestData data source.` — includes the runid. Saved; verified by re-fetching the dashboard JSON and reading the rendered `.markdown-html` body on a fresh page load.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard tags: `["bench"]`. Time range persisted as `time: {from: "now-6h", to: "now"}`; the top bar shows `Time range selected: Last 6 hours`. Both saved (required ticking "Update default time range" in the save modal — the first save had left the range URL-only).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh persisted as `refresh: "1m"`; the top bar shows `Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected` / `1m`. Saved (required ticking "Update default refresh value").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfwc3yk6mt2iod/c2agr2-bench-dashboard` — UID `cfwc3yk6mt2iod`. Also confirmed via `/api/search?query=c2agr2`, which returns it with tags `["bench"]`.

Notes on the process: the initial save of the dashboard did not persist the tag or the time range/refresh defaults — the tag needed to be added in Settings → General → Tags, and the time range and refresh needed the two "update default" checkboxes in the save modal. Both were re-verified against the saved dashboard JSON after a fresh page load.
